name: Fey Wild Shape
body:
Your wild shape is infused with wild faerie energies.

Prerequisite(s): Wild shape class feature, Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you use wild shape to take the form of an animal, you can expend an additional daily use of your wild shape class feature to add the plane of Faerie creature template to your animal form. You don’t reincarnate or reappear on Faerie if you die while in fey wild shape. If you score a critical threat against a blighted fey creature while using your form’s natural weapons, you gain a +2 bonus on the attack roll to confirm the critical hit.
